capabilities: Open upcoming daily notes relative to today or the active note's date
Close all daily notes opened by the plugin
Configure settings before using the commands
extras: The README tells users to check plugin settings before using the provided commands.
intentEvidence: opens upcoming (and/or past) daily notes in their own panes/tabs/windows
problem: Obsidian's Daily notes only opens one note at a time, making it hard to see and plan future days side by side.
summary: Opens upcoming or past daily notes in their own panes, tabs or windows so you can plan ahead.
